The issuer demonstrates an exceptional solvency profile with virtually no debt (Total Liabilities of $7M against $2,005M in Shareholders' Equity) and solid profitability with an 9.3% EBIT margin and $267M in Net Income. While the balance sheet leverage is minimal enough to support a top-tier rating, the absolute scale of revenue ($5.18B) and earnings reflects a large but not dominant market position compared to mega-cap AAA issuers, placing it solidly in the high-grade category.

DECISION: AA
